maps.points.tower_level5.a01.title: Go downstairs → Tower Level 4
maps.points.tower_level5.detail: You sense your journey is nearing its end. Whatever happens next, there will be no turning back.
maps.points.tower_level5.detail-3: The wizard lies broken upon the stone. His breathing is shallow.
maps.points.tower_level5.detail-5: Step on the sensor at (3, -7) to begin talking with the Archmage. Choose "Draw Weapons" or "Decline Participation", or continue the confrontation in the Judgment branch (you can also throw out Grgla's Fish or the Unknown Tincture).
maps.points.tower_level5.dialogue: His eyes find you. There is no anger in them.
maps.points.tower_level5.dialogue-10: The runes along the walls flare to life.
maps.points.tower_level5.dialogue-11: A deep rumble sounds below the tower as something ancient unlocks.
maps.points.tower_level5.dialogue-15: His eyes close. The presence within him unravels, slipping into nothing.
maps.points.tower_level5.dialogue-16: Follow up dialogue (Missing: Soulcleaver, Deep Furnace Axe)
maps.points.tower_level5.dialogue-18: THEN WE ALL... "die... here..." The last words come from his mouth, barely formed.
maps.points.tower_level5.dialogue-19: Pressure builds within the chamber, sudden and violent.
maps.points.tower_level5.dialogue-20: Lightning tears through the tower. Stone splits beneath your feet as ancient wards overload.
maps.points.tower_level5.dialogue-22: Stone and flame swallow everything in a single, deafening moment.
maps.points.tower_level5.dialogue-3: YOU... DO NOT KNOW... WHAT YOU HAVE DONE...
maps.points.tower_level5.dialogue-4: Follow up dialogue (Holding: Soulcleaver, Deep Furnace Axe)
maps.points.tower_level5.dialogue-5: His gaze shifts to the Soulforge Axe.
maps.points.tower_level5.dialogue-7: His hand rises weakly toward the weapon.
maps.points.tower_level5.title: Defeat the Wizard
maps.points.tower_level5.title-2: Approach the tower and reach the end
